body: Issue sweep: partly done on upstream/main. Leave this issue open. Done: commit d18b8641b (PR #1814, #1388) adds explain support in assets/posts/haas.cps, pinned by crates/post/tests/explain_fanuc_family.rs and crates/post/tests/golden/explain/haas.nc. Also afterOp() restores G90 after G28 retract. Still open in assets/posts/haas.cps: restore G90 before M30 in onClose() or emit G53 retract with Y0, and document the retract choice in docs/decisions/. Add G94 to startPreamble(). Declare millSpindleReverse = true and emit M4 for reverse MillSpindle. Add G74 left-hand tapping in onCycle(). Emit M89 when M88 stops, and emit M74 or M84 when M73 or M83 stops. Update tests in crates/post/ and crates/app/tests/golden/nc/haas/.

Reference check against the Haas Mill Programming Workbook (the maker's training document; local copy, not attached).

- **G28 retract and G90 restore** (Program Ending Lines, p. 43; Reference Point and Return, p. 49): `G28` on specific axes uses `G91` with a zero move (such as `G28 G91 Z0`) to skip the intermediate point. `G28` ignores tool length offsets. The programmer must restore `G90` before the next absolute move. **differs**: `retractHome()` writes `G91 G28 Z0` (and `G28 X0 Y0`), and `afterOp()` restores `G90`, but `onClose()` leaves `G91` active before `M30`.
- **G53 retract and G49 cancel** (Program Ending Lines, p. 43; Another Way to Return to Machine Zero, p. 50): `G53` moves in machine coordinates without changing to `G91`. `G53` is non-modal and returns to the active work offset on the next block. The workbook cancels tool length offsets with `G49` on the `G53` block and moves `Z0.` (and `Y0.` at program end). **differs**: in `G53` mode, `retractHome()` writes `G53 G0 Z<safeRetractZ>` without `G49` and without a `Y0` move.
- **G94 feed per minute** (Preparatory "G" Codes List, p. 16; Machine Defaults, p. 18): `G94` (Group 05) is the power-on default on the Haas mill. It does not conflict with `G17`, `G90`, `G54`–`G59`, `G40`, `G49`, or `G80` on the same block. **differs**: `startPreamble()` writes `G17 G90 <wcsWord> G40 G49 G80` without `G94`.
- **M4 reverse spindle** (Often Used M Codes, p. 19; M Code Detailed Description, p. 118): `M04` starts the spindle counterclockwise at the programmed `S` speed. Leading zeros are optional (Definitions Within the Format, p. 11), so `M4` is equivalent. The workbook warns against using `M04` with Through-Spindle Coolant active, and allows only one M-code per block (p. 116). **differs**: `haas.cps` does not declare `millSpindleReverse = true` and only writes `M3`.
- **G74 reverse tapping** (Preparatory "G" Codes List, p. 15; Reverse Tapping Canned Cycle, p. 83): `G74` (Group 09, modal) cuts left-hand threads with `Z`, `R`, and `F` (plus optional `X`, `Y`, `J`, `L`). It uses `G98` or `G99` return planes and starts the spindle counterclockwise automatically, so the program does not need `M04` before it. **differs**: `onCycle()` only writes `G84` for tapping and has no `G74` path.
- **Coolant-off M-codes** (Miscellaneous "M" Codes List, pp. 20–21; M Code Detailed Description, pp. 118–120, 123): `M09` turns off `M08` flood coolant. `M89` turns off `M88` Through-Spindle Coolant (stops the spindle, stops the pump, and purges). `M84` turns off `M83` Auto Air Jet. `M00`, `M01`, `M06`, and `M30` also turn off Through-Spindle Coolant. **differs**: `endPreamble()` always writes `M9` for any active coolant code instead of `M89` for `M88` or `M84` for `M83`. `M07` (mist) and `M73`/`M74` (air blast): **not covered by the workbook**.
- **Parenthesized comments** (Program Structure, p. 23; Alphabetical Address Codes, p. 26): the control ignores text inside `(...)` and shows comments from the first three lines in the program list. The workbook states no length limit for comments. **matches**: `haas.cps` sets `explains = "paren"` and writes `(...)` comments.

Settled: `G94` fits the startup block, `M4` starts CCW rotation, `G74` matches `G84` words, `M89` stops `M88`, `M84` stops `M83`, and `G53` needs `G49`. Still open: `M07` and `M73`/`M74` need NGC manual verification, and the retract choice (`G28 G91` with `G90`, or `G53 G49` with `Y0`) remains open.
